claims.quote: Described from 'Chantaboon, Southeast Siam' which corresponds to modern day Chanthaburi Province, eastern Thailand and presumably the river drainage of the same name.
It's apparently restricted to this area with distribution extending into southwestern Cambodia, though to date we've been unable to locate any definitive record pertaining to the latter country.
Asia: Mekong and Chao Phrya (Thailand) basins as well as basins around the upper Gulf of Thailand.
